What's New in These Books

Changes to the advanced color imaging books include
  • a revised format, with additional hypertext cross-references for more effective online viewing
  • detailed descriptions of new features in ColorSync 2.1 (see "ColorSync 2.1 Changes" in this document for details), with additional sample code
  • minor corrections to previous material
Subsequent sections in this document describe the changes to the advanced color imaging books in detail and contain hypertext links to new and revised material.
